Epic Games to develop AI-only Disney shooter

Epic Games announced plans to develop a new Disney shooter game that will be "AI-only," meaning it will be built entirely using artificial intelligence. The company has delayed the game's development to incorporate this AI-only approach. This marks Epic Games' first major budget game to be developed solely with AI.
